normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a bowl that is never used and end with a pillar that holds nothing up.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一只从不用来盛东西的碗开始，落到一根什么也不承的柱子。

normal.en: A decorative plate is beautiful and hungry.
normal.cn: 装饰盘很美，而且永远空着。

normal.en: Something decorative earns its place by being seen.
normal.cn: 装饰性的东西靠被看见来证明自己的位置。

normal.en: The prettiest buttons never do up anything.
normal.cn: 最好看的扣子，从来不扣住什么。

normal.en: Beauty that pretends to be structure is the best disguise.
normal.cn: 装成结构的美丽，是最好的伪装。

normal.en: Decorat- is the stem, -ive is the label, useful or not.
normal.cn: decorat- 是词干，-ive 是标签，至于有没有用另说。

abstract.en: Picture a painted bowl on a shelf.
abstract.cn: 想象架子上摆着一只画了花的碗。

abstract.en: Picture a column that ends in mid air.
abstract.cn: 想象一根在半空中就断了的柱子。

abstract.en: Picture a curtain that hides nothing.
abstract.cn: 想象一道什么也没遮住的帘子。

examples.en: The plate is purely decorative.
examples.cn: 这只盘子纯粹是装饰品。

examples.en: Decorative tiles cover the whole wall.
examples.cn: 装饰瓷砖铺满了整面墙。

examples.en: The handle is decorative but still works.
examples.cn: 这个把手是装饰性的，但仍然能用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 decorative 记成「得客来秀」：de 是得，corative 听着像「客来秀」，客人来了就秀一秀那些只为好看的东西。

root: 来自拉丁语 decorativus（能装点的），后缀 -ivus 表示性质，源头仍是 decorare（装点）与 decus（美与荣誉）。十八世纪随美术话题进入英语，用来区分「只为好看」与「真正有用」。

sensesIntro.en: From an object made only for the eye, to a part that adds beauty without bearing weight.
sensesIntro.cn: 从只为眼睛而做的物件，到只添美而不承重的部件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a painted bowl that never holds water.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只画着花、从不盛水的碗。

branches.en: The first sense is an object with no job but to be seen.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是除被看见之外没有任务的东西。

branches.en: The second sense is a part that beautifies something else.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是给别的东西添美的部件。

branches.en: Both senses put beauty ahead of function.
branches.cn: 两个义项都把好看放在功用前面。

branches.en: One names a whole object, the other a part of one.
branches.cn: 一个指整个物件，一个指物件的一部分。

branches.en: A decorative part often pretends to be a working one.
branches.cn: 装饰性的部件，常常装成有用的样子。

intro.en: Decorative is the adjective of quality in the decorate family.
intro.cn: decorative 是 decorate 一族里表示性质的那个形容词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin suffix -ivus marks a quality, added to decorare, to adorn.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁后缀 -ivus 表示性质，加在 decorare（装点）之上。

items.example: A decorative arch frames the door.
items.exampleCN: 一道装饰性的拱框住了门。

items.example: The decorations are stored upstairs.
items.exampleCN: 装饰品收在楼上。

items.example: They decorate the shop each winter.
items.exampleCN: 他们每年冬天装饰店铺。

items.example: The decorator suggested warmer colours.
items.exampleCN: 装饰工建议用更暖的颜色。

items.example: The stones are laid decoratively.
items.exampleCN: 石头被摆成装饰的样子。

items.example: They praised the decorativeness of the gate.
items.exampleCN: 他们称赞这道门的装饰性。

items.example: The undecorated wall looked severe.
items.exampleCN: 没有装饰的墙显得冷峻。

items.example: She studies the decorative arts.
items.exampleCN: 她研究装饰艺术。

definition_en: to become or make something smaller in number or size
core_image: 水位在杯壁上一点点退下去
scene: 关掉几盏灯之后，电费单上的数字小了不少。The number of visitors decreased in winter.
sceneCN: 这里 decrease 指「减少」（第 1 个义项：数量变小）；句意是冬天游客数量减少了。

senses.title: Become smaller by itself
senses.definition: to fall in number, size or amount
senses.definitionCN: 数量、大小或额度下降
senses.example: The number of visitors decreased in winter.
senses.exampleCN: 冬天游客数量减少了。
senses.why: A quantity that shrinks leaves a smaller mark on the page.
senses.whyCN: 缩小的数量，在纸上留下的痕迹也小了一圈。

senses.title: Bring something down
senses.definition: to make a number or level go down on purpose
senses.definitionCN: 有意识地让数字或水平降下来
senses.example: The factory decreased its water use by half.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂把用水量减少了一半。
senses.why: The same change can happen by itself or by a hand.
senses.whyCN: 同样的变化，可以自己发生，也可以由一只手推动。

senses.title: The size of a fall
senses.definition: the measured amount by which something falls
senses.definitionCN: 测量出来的下降幅度
senses.example: There was a small decrease in prices last month.
senses.exampleCN: 上个月价格有小幅下降。
senses.why: Once a fall is measured, it becomes a thing you can name.
senses.whyCN: 一次下跌一旦被量出来，就成了可以称呼的东西。

intro.en: Decrease came from Latin decrescere, to grow less, from crescere, to grow.
intro.cn: decrease 来自拉丁语 decrescere（变少），源于 crescere（生长）。

items.en: Crescere meant to grow or increase.
items.cn: crescere 指生长、增加。

items.en: Decrescere meant to grow less or shrink.
items.cn: decrescere 指长得更少、缩小。

items.en: Decroistre carried the same sense into French.
items.cn: decroistre 把同样的意思带进法语。

items.en: Decrease entered English as a verb of shrinking.
items.cn: decrease 作为表示缩小的动词进入英语。

items.en: The noun came later, naming the size of the fall.
items.cn: 名词用法更晚，用来指下降的幅度。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the de- opening, and the meaning group all describe things going down.
note.cn: 形近组都以 de- 开头，近义组则都在说往下走。

normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从杯壁上退下去的水开始，落到纸面上被量出来的一次下跌。

normal.en: Water leaves a glass without a sound and the mark stays.
normal.cn: 水悄无声息地离开杯子，痕迹留下了。

normal.en: Turning off lights is decrease you can see on a bill.
normal.cn: 关灯这件事，能在账单上看见。

normal.en: Growth and decrease use the same root, only the direction differs.
normal.cn: 增加和减少同出一个词根，只差一个方向。

normal.en: Decrease by half is easier to say than to do.
normal.cn: 「减半」说起来，比做起来容易得多。

normal.en: A decrease is a fall small enough to measure.
normal.cn: 减少量就是小到可以量出来的那次下跌。

abstract.en: Picture a ring left on a glass by lower water.
abstract.cn: 想象杯壁上被退下去的水留下的一圈印。

abstract.en: Picture a meter turning back one number.
abstract.cn: 想象一只表往回退了一个数。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd leaving a hall one row at a time.
abstract.cn: 想象人群一排一排地离开大厅。

examples.en: The number of visitors decreased in winter.
examples.cn: 冬天游客数量减少了。

examples.en: We must decrease the amount of waste we produce.
examples.cn: 我们必须减少产生的垃圾量。

examples.en: There was a slight decrease in traffic after the new road opened.
examples.cn: 新路开通后交通量略有下降。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 decrease 记成「得亏少」：de 是得，crease 像「亏少」，账上亏得少了，就是数量在往下走。

root: 源自拉丁语 decrescere（变少），由 de（向下）与 crescere（生长）构成，字面意思就是「往下长」。十五世纪作为动词进入英语，名词用法出现得更晚，用来指下降的幅度。

sensesIntro.en: From a number falling by itself, to a hand pushing it down, to the measured size of the fall.
sensesIntro.cn: 从数字自行下降，到一只手把它按下去，再到这次下降被量出的幅度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: water slipping down the inside of a glass.
core.cn: 核心意象：水沿着杯子内壁缓缓退下。

branches.en: The first sense is a quantity going down without help.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是数量自己往下走。

branches.en: The second sense is someone pushing the quantity down.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是有人把数量按下去。

branches.en: The third sense turns the fall into a figure on paper.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把这次下跌变成纸上的一个数字。

branches.en: The change looks the same whoever causes it.
branches.cn: 不管是谁造成的，这个变化看起来一样。

branches.en: A trend is only many small decreases added together.
branches.cn: 所谓趋势，不过是许多次小幅减少加在一起。

intro.en: Decrease shares its stem with increase, concrete and crescent: all grow from crescere.
intro.cn: decrease 与 increase、concrete、crescent 共用一个词干，都从 crescere 长出来。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is crescere, to grow, with the prefix de- pulling it downward.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 crescere（生长），前缀 de- 把它往下拉。

items.example: Numbers decrease after midnight.
items.exampleCN: 午夜之后数量会减少。

items.example: They watched the decreasing figures.
items.exampleCN: 他们看着不断减少的数字。

items.example: He went out decreasingly often.
items.exampleCN: 他出门越来越少。

items.example: Each step is a decrement of one.
items.exampleCN: 每一步都减一。

items.example: There was a decrease in noise.
items.exampleCN: 噪音有所减少。

items.example: The sharp decrease surprised the bank.
items.exampleCN: 急剧减少让银行吃了一惊。

items.example: Bird numbers are on the decrease.
items.exampleCN: 鸟类数量正在减少。

items.example: Good sleep decreases the risk of illness.
items.exampleCN: 好的睡眠能降低患病风险。

latinEntries.example: Crescere gives English increase and decrease.
latinEntries.exampleCN: crescere 给英语带来 increase 和 decrease。

definition_en: going a long way down from the top or the surface
core_image: 从井口往下望，看不见底
scene: 井口往下望，黑洞洞的，看不到底。The well is deep and cold.
sceneCN: 这里 deep 指「深的」（第 1 个义项：从上往下距离大）；句意是这口井又深又冷。

senses.title: Far from top to bottom
senses.definition: reaching a long way down from the surface
senses.definitionCN: 从表面向下的距离很长
senses.example: The well is deep and cold.
senses.exampleCN: 这口井又深又冷。
senses.why: Distance downward is the first thing the eye cannot measure.
senses.whyCN: 往下的距离，是眼睛最先量不出来的东西。

senses.title: Strong and serious
senses.definition: intense, serious, or felt with great force
senses.definitionCN: 强烈、严肃或感受极重的
senses.example: She fell into a deep sleep after the journey.
senses.exampleCN: 旅途之后她沉沉睡去。
senses.why: What goes far down inside a person is also called deep.
senses.whyCN: 一个人内里沉得很深的东西，也叫 deep。

senses.title: The deepest part
senses.definition: the part of something furthest from the surface
senses.definitionCN: 某物离表面最远的那一部分
senses.example: Strange fish live in the deep.
senses.exampleCN: 奇怪的鱼生活在深处。
senses.why: A place that is far down can be named as a place.
senses.whyCN: 离表面很远的地方，可以当成一个地点来称呼。

intro.en: Deep is an Old English word, deop, from a Germanic root meaning hollow and far down.
intro.cn: deep 是古英语词 deop，来自一个意为「中空、深陷」的日耳曼词根。

items.en: The root named what lies far below the surface.
items.cn: 这个词根指位于表面之下很远的地方。

items.en: Deop described wells, water and valleys.
items.cn: deop 形容井、水与山谷。

items.en: The word moved from ground to feeling and thought.
items.cn: 这个词从地面挪到了情感与思想上。

items.en: Deep colours and deep sleep borrowed the idea of fullness.
items.cn: 深色与熟睡借用了「满而沉」的意思。

items.en: Deep now measures both space and intensity.
items.cn: 如今 deep 既量空间，也量强度。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one letter, and the meaning group moves from literal depth to intensity.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个字母，近义组则从实指的深走到抽象的重。

entries.definition: to consider something to be true
to put something quickly into liquid
an action that is done
very deep in feeling or thought
entries.definitionCN: 在感情或思想上极深的

entries.definition: having no bottom that can be reached
very strong in degree

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a well that has no visible bottom and end with a feeling that has no floor either.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一口望不到底的井开始，落到一份同样没有底的感情。

normal.en: A deep well and a deep grief are both measured by how long the echo takes.
normal.cn: 深井和深悲，都靠回声多久才回来来衡量。

normal.en: The surface tells you nothing; the rope tells you everything.
normal.cn: 表面什么也不说，绳子才说明一切。

normal.en: Deep sleep is a room with the lights off.
normal.cn: 熟睡是一间关了灯的房间。

normal.en: A deep voice comes from the chest, not the throat.
normal.cn: 低沉的声音来自胸腔，不来自喉咙。

normal.en: Depth is deep plus -th, the shape of the distance itself.
normal.cn: depth 是 deep 加 -th，正是那段距离本身的形状。

abstract.en: Picture a coin falling and no sound coming back.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚硬币落下去，却没有回声传回来。

abstract.en: Picture a diver's light fading into blue.
abstract.cn: 想象潜水员的灯光渐渐没入蓝色。

abstract.en: Picture a person quiet for a long time and then speaking one true sentence.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人沉默很久，然后说出一句真话。

examples.en: The well is deep and cold.
examples.cn: 这口井又深又冷。

examples.en: He took a deep breath and began to speak.
examples.cn: 他深吸一口气，开口说话。

examples.en: The lake is deepest near the middle.
examples.cn: 湖中央一带最深。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 deep 记成「地铺」：de 是地，ep 听着像「铺」，地铺一铺就很深，往下望不见底。

root: 源自古英语 deop，更早是日耳曼语词根，本义是「中空、深陷」。它先形容井、水与山谷，后来从地面挪到人身上，用来形容沉睡、颜色、感情与思想的浓重，抽象与具体始终共用同一个词。

sensesIntro.en: From distance below the surface, to intensity inside a person, to the far place itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 从表面之下的距离，到人内里的强烈，再到那个很远的地点本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: looking down a well and seeing no bottom.
core.cn: 核心意象：往井里望下去，看不到底。

branches.en: The first sense is plain distance from top to bottom.
branches.cn: 第一个义项就是从上到下的距离。

branches.en: The second sense moves that distance inside a person or a colour.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把这段距离挪进了人心里或颜色里。

branches.en: The third sense turns the far-down place into a noun.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把那个很下面的地方变成了名词。

branches.en: Space and feeling share one image of going down.
branches.cn: 空间与情感，共用「往下走」这一幅画面。

branches.en: What is deep can also be visited as a place.
branches.cn: 深的东西，也能当成一个地方走进去。

intro.en: Deep grows into deeply, deepen, depth and a set of compounds about the sea and roots.
intro.cn: deep 长出 deeply、deepen、depth，以及一批与深海、深根有关的复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin element in deep; Latin used altus and profundus for the same idea.
latinIntro.cn: deep 里没有拉丁成分，拉丁语用 altus 和 profundus 表示同样的意思。

items.example: The water is deep here.
items.exampleCN: 这里的水很深。

items.example: She was deeply moved.
items.exampleCN: 她被深深打动了。

items.example: They deepened the channel last year.
items.exampleCN: 他们去年把水道挖深了。

items.example: The depth of the pool is two metres.
items.exampleCN: 泳池的深度是两米。

items.example: The deepness of the silence surprised him.
items.exampleCN: 那份沉默之深让他吃惊。

items.example: Deep-sea fish rarely come up.
items.exampleCN: 深海鱼很少浮上来。

items.example: It is a deep-rooted habit.
items.exampleCN: 这是个根深蒂固的习惯。

items.meaning: placed far back in the face
items.example: He has deep-set eyes.
items.exampleCN: 他有一双深陷的眼睛。
